Elena — thanks, received both attachments and skimmed the bank letter. A few quick items / requests so we can finalize in the next 48 hours: 

- Invoice labeling: please include the PO on the invoice header as "PO#: 4832" and also put the same PO# in the invoice filename (e.g., invoice_4832_202605.pdf). That ensures automated mapping in our AP portal.

- Remit string: our payments system accepts up to 140 characters in the remit/note field. Please include the invoice number and your internal reference (if any). Example remit string we prefer: 
  "Redwood PO#4832 | PineGrove INV#2026-081"

- ACH vs Wire: ACH is preferred. If you confirm ACH, we'll schedule two micro-deposits (small values) to the account on file — typically they post within 1-2 business days. Once you confirm the amounts, we'll mark the account active. If you prefer wire for the first payout, let us know and we'll route instructions.

I've attached a short CSV template for invoice filename/remit examples to reduce back-and-forth: [payment_instructions_template.csv].

I'll loop Priyom to confirm the first payout window and to create the PO internally. Vanessa, can you add PineGrove to the portal once ACH is confirmed?

Thanks,
